name: Color-Based Segmentation of Image Regions
description:
You are designing a computer vision pipeline for vegetable sorting. Open the 'Peppers' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Peppers). This image contains red, green, and yellow peppers. Your goal is to create a binary mask that isolates ONLY the green pepper, excluding the red/yellow peppers and the background.

Steps:
1. Open the 'Peppers' sample image.
2. Use the Color Threshold tool (Image > Adjust > Color Threshold) or similar color segmentation methods.
3. Adjust the parameters (likely Hue/Saturation/Brightness) to select only the green pepper.
4. Generate a binary mask (white object on black background).
5. Save this binary mask as a PNG file to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/green_pepper_mask.png'.

The mask should have pixel values of 0 (black) for background/other peppers and 255 (white) for the green pepper.
